title: Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol
content:
SOP: Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol (SOP-END-001)
DEPARTMENT: Gastroenterology
VERSION: 1.8
ROLES: doctor, endoscopy_nurse
PURPOSE: Patient conscious sedation monitoring and enzymatic scope disinfection.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol in full compliance with Gastroenterology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol in full compliance with Gastroenterology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol in full compliance with Gastroenterology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol in full compliance with Gastroenterology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol in full compliance with Gastroenterology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol in full compliance with Gastroenterology hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Gastroenterology.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-END-001 Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Protocol v1.8, Section 4
